tools.name: describe_project
tools.description: "Use this tool when you need a representation of the project structure, including available assets like models, audio, maps, and UI components."

tools.name: get_model_animations
tools.description: Use this tool when you need to get the list of available animations for a specific model. Provide just the model name without the path or extension.

modelName.description: The name of the model to get animations for. This is the model that you would call the startModelAnimation function with. Do not include the full path, just the name of the model

tools.name: read_me_first
tools.description: Start here to get an overview of how to use the Hytopia SDK and understand its core concepts.

tools.name: full-game-example
tools.description: Get a complete example of an end to end Hytopia SDK game.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Get a list of all available models in the project, including their formats and animations.

tools.name: list_audio
tools.description: Get a list of all available audio files in the project.

tools.name: help
tools.description:
Get help with a specific topic. Currently supports:
- ui: Get help with UI-related functionality
- physics: Get help with physics-related functionality
- events: Get help with events-related functionality
- audio: Get help with audio-related functionality
- entity: Get help with entity-related functionality

You use these tools frequently to get up to date knowledge about sections in the Hytopia SDK.
You use these tools every time you are going to implement some code related to a topic covered here.
You do not have any knowledge of the Hytopia SDK except for the documentation provided.

instructions:
Hytopia SDK Helper is a repository of instructions on how to build games with the Hytopia SDK.
		It also contains various helper functions that you can call to interact with the Hytopia SDK IDE.
		
		You should begin by exploring the full-game-example tool/resource to get a full end to end example of building a game with the Hytopia SDK.

		You should always call the respective helper sections before starting to implement something in that section.
		For example, before you start building the UI, you should call the helper UI tool. You should do this every time no matter what.
